notes: Cash basis school district. Governmental figures from Total Governmental Funds column (p6-7); business-type from School Nutrition proprietary fund (p8-9). Other nonrevenue receipts 254,554 split into 109,631 other and 144,923 interfund loan (transfers_in) using p16. Nonmajor non-program expenditures 144,923 (Special Building interfund loan, p23) taken out of disbursements as transfers_out; printed total disbursements 28,015,100 includes it. Reclassification of 61,184 Employee Benefit transfer already eliminated in the statement total column (p14 shows Instruction 11,389,668 after reclass); in General Fund budget detail (p17) Instruction lines total 11,450,852, so a contra line and other financing -61,184 were added. General Fund detail uses the budget schedule (pp15-19), which is more detailed than the combining schedule (pp11-14); combining schedule not recorded to avoid double counting; its Depreciation and Employee Benefit columns are recorded from pp20 and 24. Combined schedule p10 not recorded. Student Fee Fund (p26) is not in the governmental fund totals (nonmajor = QCPUF + Special Building) so it is treated as outside scope (fiduciary/activity) and skipped. General Fund budget schedule ending fund balance 8,469,914 (p19) differs from statement 8,324,991 by the 144,923 due from Depreciation Fund; QCPUF, Bond, Special Building budget schedules are the Aggregate Nonmajor/Bond fund columns. Governmental roll-forward: 9,487,678 + 26,085,403 receipts - 27,870,177 disbursements + 144,923 - 144,923 + 3,545,000 = 11,247,904.
